Let’s spike up the drama with our new blog.
By admin
19 Mar 2018
0 Comments
We had a makeover! And while we were at it, we decided to add a blog to our new theatre website. Connect with us weekly to find out what’s new. Check out our drama resources, useful tips for actors, teachers and directors, our latest classes and much more. Sign up for our mailing list if you wish to keep informed about plays and shows in Hong Kong.
We look forward to seeing you all around here.
Have a fantastic week!
Aurora xx
